From epic Tanzania safari adventures spotting Africa’s Big Five, to climbing Kilimanjaro or relaxing on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania has it all. Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: For many people, discovering everything Tanzania offers is a dream. Tanzania has it all: thrilling safaris in search of Africa’s Big Five, a climb up Kilimanjaro, or time to unwind on the beautiful beaches of Zanzibar. The good news is that Your Tanzania Trip can put together a custom made itinerary that matches all your wishes.

blocks.html: We are happy to help, whether you go for one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or would rather adapt the journey to your own plans. Join us and get ready to discover Tanzania at your own pace, just the way you want!

blocks.orig: As you walk out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your personal Your Tanzania Trip guide greets you with a big smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' The guide takes you straight to your hotel, where you can relax and take in the African atmosphere. The next day your guide takes you on an exclusive, private safari that allows you to travel at your own pace. Enjoy the luxury of your own safari jeep and take the liberty to stop and watch the animals as long as you like!
blocks.html: When you step out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your personal Your Tanzania Trip guide is waiting for you with a broad smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' You are driven directly to your hotel, where you can unwind and soak up the African atmosphere. On the following day your guide takes you out on an exclusive, private safari where you set the pace yourself. You have your own safari jeep, so feel free to stop and watch the animals for as long as you want!

blocks.orig: Tarangire National Park is well known for its big groups of elephants and the huge amount of giant baobab trees. These trees can live for hundreds of years and are actually a source of water for elephants in the dry season as they have a special technique to draw water from them. Besides, the Tarangire River is the only source of water in the dry season, which is why in this season in Tarangire you can see groups of up to 250 elephants next to many more animals!
blocks.html: Large herds of elephants and countless giant baobab trees are what Tarangire National Park is known for. A baobab can reach an age of hundreds of years, and in the dry season the elephants use these trees as a water source, thanks to a special technique for drawing water from them. In the dry season the Tarangire River is also the only water source around, so at that time of year you can see herds of up to 250 elephants in Tarangire, alongside many other animals!

blocks.orig: Serengeti National Park is widely known as the place to go on safari, mainly because of the Great Migration that passes through here. The enormous, stampeding herds are impressive, as are the vast number of predators that live here: over four thousand lions, over 200 cheetahs, a thousand leopards, 3500 hyenas, and hundreds of wild dogs! And of course, plenty of other beautiful animals, which your guide will be delighted to search for together with you. Are you ready for this?
blocks.html: Serengeti National Park is famous as the place for a safari, largely thanks to the Great Migration that moves through the park. The huge thundering herds are impressive, and so are the many predators living here: more than four thousand lions, more than 200 cheetahs, a thousand leopards, 3500 hyenas and hundreds of wild dogs! There are of course lots of other beautiful animals too, and your guide will gladly go looking for them with you. Are you ready?

blocks.orig: The famous Ngorongoro Crater is one of Africa's seven natural wonders. The crater was formed two million years ago when a vast volcano erupted. The fertile lava has created a unique ecosystem, now home to the highest concentration of animals found anywhere in Africa! Once in the crater, thousands of animals such as lions, zebras, buffalos and black rhinos surround you, and the views are astounding – you won’t know where to look!
blocks.html: The well-known Ngorongoro Crater counts as one of Africa's seven natural wonders. It was created two million years ago, when a huge volcano erupted. The fertile lava produced a unique ecosystem that now holds the highest density of animals anywhere in Africa! Inside the crater you are surrounded by thousands of animals, including lions, zebras, buffalos and black rhinos, and the scenery is stunning – you will not know where to look first!

blocks.orig: The Manyara Best View Lodge near Lake Manyara National Park is the perfect place for a day of rest in between safaris. You can spend the whole day at the infinity pool in the lodge, and enjoy the good service and amazing views. Or you go out and about and discover the many things you can do in the near vicinity - go mountain biking, visit a local market, hike along the Great Rift Valley wall or the lake, or go on a night game drive. The choice is yours!
blocks.html: For a rest day between safaris, the Manyara Best View Lodge near Lake Manyara National Park is the perfect spot. You can stay at the lodge's infinity pool all day long and enjoy the good service and wonderful views. Alternatively, head out and explore the many activities close by: go mountain biking, visit a local market, walk along the lake or the wall of the Great Rift Valley, or join a night game drive. It is up to you!

blocks.orig: Experience a truly relaxing day on safari outside the park. Immerse yourself in the breathtaking natural beauty on a serene journey. Indulge in nature walks, birdwatching, or simply unwind amidst the stunning surroundings. Capture remarkable memories, rejuvenate your senses, and connect with the tranquil wilderness. Unwind and enjoy a peaceful escape away from the hustle and bustle, surrounded by the wonders of Tanzania's pristine landscapes.
blocks.html: Spend a truly relaxing safari day outside the park. Take in the breathtaking natural beauty on a calm journey. Enjoy nature walks or birdwatching, or simply unwind in the beautiful surroundings. Make memories worth keeping, refresh your senses and feel connected to the quiet wilderness. Relax and enjoy a peaceful break far from the hustle and bustle, with the wonders of Tanzania's unspoilt landscapes all around you.

blocks.orig: Today you fly to the spice island of Zanzibar. Our guide picks you up at the airport and takes you to your hotel. Over the next few days, you can discover white sandy beaches, crystal-clear turquoise waters and vibrant coral reefs. Into culture? Then head to Stone Town and dive into the history of this fascinating little town. Food lovers can also visit the spice plantations and discover the diverse flavours of the delicious local cuisine. A tropical paradise awaits you!
blocks.html: Today you take a flight to Zanzibar, the spice island. Our guide meets you at the airport and drives you to your hotel. In the days that follow you can explore white sandy beaches, clear turquoise water and colourful coral reefs. Interested in culture? Go to Stone Town and learn about the history of this fascinating small town. If you love food, you can also visit the spice plantations and taste the varied flavours of the excellent local cuisine. A tropical paradise is waiting for you!

blocks.orig: Ultimate paradise is here: gorgeous, tropical Zanzibar! The clear blue waters of the Indian Ocean and the palm-fringed, white sandy beaches are almost too beautiful to be true. Buy your coconut drink fresh on the beach, spend hours sunbathing or swimming, and taste the delicious Zanzibari food. In the mood for something active? Then explore the beach, ocean, and island through a range of activities! We highly recommend the Safari Blue Cruise or a tour of Stone Town.
blocks.html: This is paradise: beautiful, tropical Zanzibar! With the clear blue Indian Ocean and white sandy beaches lined with palm trees, it almost seems too beautiful to be real. Get a fresh coconut drink on the beach, sunbathe or swim for hours, and try the tasty Zanzibari cuisine. Feel like doing something active? Discover the beach, the ocean and the island with a variety of activities! The Safari Blue Cruise and a Stone Town tour are two we warmly recommend.

blocks.orig: The last day! Depending on your flight time, you can relax on the beach or explore the island just a little bit more. Then, make your way to Zanzibar International Airport in time for your flight home. Having second thoughts? It's also possible to extend your holiday to another paradise island, such as Mnemba, Pemba, or Mafia!
blocks.html: Your final day! Depending on when your flight leaves, you can enjoy the beach or see a little more of the island. After that you travel to Zanzibar International Airport to catch your flight home. Not ready to leave yet? You can also extend your holiday on another paradise island, such as Mnemba, Pemba or Mafia!
